rationale: The agent did run user lookup and order/product detail tools, but then executed an exchange write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first obtaining explicit user confirmation, which violates the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. Additionally, it exchanged two items (water bottle and desk lamp) in one action; per the user’s instruction, if asked for confirmation, only the desk lamp should be exchanged. There is no evidence of a confirmation step or of aligning the replacements with the user’s stated preferences before committing. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
